Scope: playgrounds at three locations (Qassim Oasis, Hail and Tabuk Industrial City), with civil, architectural, electrical, mechanical and landscape works and general site works, including air domes at Qassim and Tabuk and a toilet building at each site.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours (weekly report, Physical Progress sheet). At 25-Oct-2026 the project is 77.64% complete against 83.26% planned, behind by 5.62% (SPI 0.93). It gained 2.85% this week against 3.01% planned, so the gap widened slightly.

The schedule now finishes the project 60 days after the contract date. The P6 update (data date 23-Oct-2026) and the weekly report both forecast handover on 14-Feb-2027 against the contract completion date of 16-Dec-2026, with −50.8 days of float; last week's report forecast 07-Feb-2027. 169 of the 300 open activities have negative float and 39 activities have failed to start. The air domes are furthest behind: Qassim 39.96% against 79.84% planned and Tabuk 35.13% against 74.55%.

Data notes

  • Progress figures are the weekly report's physical progress (effort), weighted by 33,340 budgeted man-hours, of which 10,000 belong to the “Project milestone” management line. The report's cover and dashboard also show cost-based progress labelled as actual; this report uses physical progress only.
  • The report states “Current Contract Weeks: 0 of 0”, so the week number is counted from site handover (17-Feb-2026): week 35.
  • The “Weekly Physical Progress” columns hold 75.05% planned and 68.08% earned, which match neither week's to-date figures. Progress this week is taken as the change in to-date progress since the 18-Oct-2026 report.
  • All major quantities are identical to the 18-Oct-2026 report, although work was reported this week; the sheet appears not to have been updated.
  • Man-hours by site: Tabuk toilet building shows 0 of 1,708 man-hours earned with only 40 planned, and Tabuk closeout has no budget but 62 man-hours earned.
  • The milestone sheet gives complete mobilisation as 14-Apr-2026 against 18-Mar-2026 with 0 days change, and complete construction as 28-Oct-2026 (47 days early), which P6 does not support.
  • Procurement: the summary has 8 of 57 materials on site, while the P6 delivery activities are 70–95% complete. The procurement log has no delivered quantities or dates.
  • Invoices: the summary shows 0 submitted invoices while the log lists IPC-01 and IPC-02. Paid invoices (3,436,604 SAR) exceed the gross submitted value although none is PM-approved. The dashboard's penalties of −373,711 combine advance payment recovery and deductions.
  • Manpower: October in the Manpower sheet is 25 manual planned and 73 actual, while the dashboard shows 32 and 77. The DB sheet still holds another project's data (HAL1-02-005).
  • The P6 update has a data date of 23-Oct-2026, against 25-Oct-2026 for the weekly report; 118 in-progress activities have a finish date before the data date. Three PDFs are named MLTX-05-047 although they belong to MLTX-02-003.
  • The contractor forecast in the Physical-Chart Data sheet starts at 0 in February, 365 man-hours below the actual, so it stays slightly below actual until October.
